compatibilityOptions.option: Keep old files and add new copies
compatibilityOptions.cost: Duplicates bytes in game folders and potentially in release ZIP; directory scanning sees additional paths.

compatibilityOptions.option: Move canonical file and keep old-path NTFS hardlink
compatibilityOptions.oldSaves: Old paths continue to resolve while both directory entries share bytes.
compatibilityOptions.cost: Same volume only; ordinary ZIP/extraction/copy may materialize two independent copies; file enumeration still sees two entries; replacing either file atomically can sever the shared-file relationship.
Qt/browser/catalog/packaging traversal differences require a dedicated test; avoid unverified recursive moves or links into protected roots.

compatibilityOptions.option: Refresh old page/definition caches and remove old aliases
compatibilityOptions.oldSaves: Only safe if every stored HTML/JS/menu/path/cache supplier is migrated or rebuilt.
compatibilityOptions.cost: Largest save-compatibility and state-restoration surface; not the first simple migration choice.

nextAction: Parent must select exact operational scope after current runtime/ref/index tests. No WORK, Full, save, source image or Git mutation performed.

directoryIndexAssessment.assessment: Proposed UI sources and targets are outside the five public getImages roots. No picMax delta is expected from that implementation; installed-binary behavior still needs a before/after native snapshot before operation.

recommendedCompatibilityPlan.choice: Canonical ui paths plus old-path compatibility aliases in WORK for first migration.
recommendedCompatibilityPlan.implementationPreference: On same NTFS volume, preserve or create hardlink old/new pairs after per-file hash and collision checks; keep an explicit alias manifest. No implementation in this report.
recommendedCompatibilityPlan.why: Representative old/new-version saves both contain more than 2600 cached UI path variables. Rebuilding only the currently displayed page does not cover all cached menus and code definitions.
recommendedCompatibilityPlan.volume: G:/ NTFS confirmed with .NET DriveInfo; no CIM dependency.
recommendedCompatibilityPlan.releaseLimit: ZIP and normal copy/extraction may create separate old/new files. Patch/Full payload must explicitly state which aliases are included or inherited; no installer/link creation script is authorized by this plan.
recommendedCompatibilityPlan.updateLimit: Atomic replacement by an image editor can detach one hardlink name. Build validation must verify alias pair content equality; hardlinks are not ongoing automatic synchronization.
doNotDo: Do not remove old paths based only on current-code literal scan.
Do not rewrite historic mods in place.
Do not change character/art/scene image namespaces merely because content/pic contains them.

gitAndPackaging.sourceOwner: resources/new/<new-relative-path> for canonical new assets where tracked; preserve source provenance and explicit old-path aliases in a migration manifest.
gitAndPackaging.cssOwner: assets/css-2.4/base.css and the corresponding tracked CSS files; JS remains in its existing folder.
gitAndPackaging.qspOwner: New isolated mods/*.json migration patch against current WORK baseline, exact replay and idempotence; do not revise older path strings in historic patches.
gitAndPackaging.saveOwner: Existing saves remain read-only; no new blanket string-variable migration is assumed.
tests: Canonical path and required compatibility path both resolve to intended SHA256.
Native getImages/picMax snapshot unchanged for excluded UI moves.
Old save menu/profile/return callbacks and image display.
Current live UI click paths and tooltip/message layers.
ZIP entry list excludes backups/diagnostics/source artwork and preserves required aliases explicitly.
